chapter: Ben Webster and Jim and Andy's
title: Night of the great blackout
summary: Hinton recalls the first blackout at Jim and Andy's.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: One of my most experiencing nights was spent in there, the night of the first great blackout. I was working over there and I was in Jim and Andy's, and he served food until it ran out. There was nothing but bread on
the table. But he served, and he stayed open all night. People couldn't go home. And I never saw so many drunks, including yours truly, in all of my life.
Oh, it was a great opportunity.
It was the greatest one I ever had. Took full advantage of it. So that was a great era, Jim and Andy's.
